title: ROAD//ZERO
models: OpenAI built-in image generation (process-only reference images)
own_art_list: All shipped 3D geometry is original Three.js code produced through the 404 recipe; UI is original CSS; audio is runtime Web Audio synthesis.
what_i_found: ROAD//ZERO turns track generation into the racing mechanic itself: the road physically assembles seconds ahead of the car. SAFE and REDLINE branches make the next piece of generated road a risk/reward decision rather than scenery. The same modular construction language escalates through four continuous worlds and competitive AI racing.
